name: 24343 · Hillsville, VA
findings: ZIP 24343 (Hillsville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24343 (Hillsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24343 (Hillsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
